body: I try to log in with my Spotify (which it requires) and it says my email doesn’t exist with Spotify. I proceed to go to sign up as if it’s a new email (which maybe is the problem, I have a Spotify account but not linked with Spotiguess yet) so I put the same exact email in, but guess what, it says “this email already exists as an account” 🤨 design y’all’s app better Ts is tragic.

title: It’s okay
body: I love the quiz aspect, but the fact that you have to pay every 5 quizzes is not a good look on your game.

title: Another App Lost Behind a Pay Wall
body: This app is great! It connects you straight to your Spotify and you can quiz yourself on your music…however you can only do that five times a day. I get that running an app costs money and you need to make your money but I’d rather watch an ad after every quiz than pay to do more than five quizzes a day. Yes I’m asking for ads. Song quizzes shouldn’t cost 9 bucks a month

title: the subscription just killed this app
body: Not every application needs a subscription just do like a one time payment of like five bucks I pay that in a heartbeat it's a good app and there's hardly any like it just I'm sick and tired of apps all wanting a subscription out of people. Sure gets you the most money (a subscription) but you're still greedy bastard just like all the other ones in the market by doing so. Do better bruh -also for anyone who has a downloaded the app and is reading this you get five quizzes a day otherwise you have to pay a ridiculous reoccurring subscription
